name: Jasmine Nadya
bio: Jasmine Nadya (born May 14, 2005) is an Indonesian musician and actress under Sony Music Entertainment Indonesia. She debuted with the single Butterflies and is known for the series Mercury and the soap opera Karmila. Jasmine also played the role of Alya in the film Rangga & Cinta: The Rebirth of Ada Apa Dengan Cinta? (2025).
